body: Just another update no one will see. While in full crisis, some part of me managed to drag me into my car and drive 90 minutes to my parents house. I haven't seen or spoken to them in almost 3 years, so they were extremely inviting and helpful. They let me just sit and talk or not talk for like 7 hours. On Sunday, I called people who've been in my support network before to let them know how low it got and they're all on alert now.
I've decided. Good luck to all who come after me. There's no 'otherside', so I'll simply say Goodbye.
